title: Pending payment reminder
description: Remind buyers that their order is waiting for payment, such as a boleto or bank transfer, with a link to complete it. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Keep it a reminder about their own order, no discount offers. Include the order number so Meta sees a transactional context.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, order *#{{order_id}}* for {{amount}} is still waiting for payment. We'll hold your items until {{date}}. Thank you, and reply here if you need anything.
